per_view.notes: Slender gray tube with a flat, open-looking blunt nose cap and no upper-deck hump. Only three nacelles visible, hung near swept tapered wings; far wing reads misplaced/fin-like. Swept vertical fin plus partial stabilizer. Single thin dangling nose-gear stick with tiny wheel. Oversized square window dots in a rough line; coherent all-gray scheme.

Slender white fuselage with front-third humped upper deck and dashed window line. Swept tapered gray wings; nacelle cylinders sit near the wings but four underslung pylon-mounted engines are not clearly resolved. Rear ends in a blunt flat disc; no tall vertical fin visible from this rear quarter, only swept stabilizer-like slabs. Sparse floating gear bits under belly.

Slender grey tube with flat, untapered disk nose. Low partial hump over front third with window specks. Dark swept wings mounted far aft near the tail, little visible dihedral; roughly three nacelles visible, one appearing detached under the belly. Nose strut plus two multi-wheel bogies. Fin and tailplane crowd the wing; two-tone grey scheme.

Nose is a flat circular disk with no taper; hump front shows a dark open gap where a faired cockpit should be. Partial-length upper deck with its own window row ends near front third. Three nacelles visible under swept wings (fourth cut by frame). Nose strut plus small under-body wheel clusters look thin and floaty. Monochrome grey scheme.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Landing gear (nose gear + 4-truck main gear) when visible' (mean 4/10). Target the 8 anchor: nose gear plus four main-gear trucks under the wing/body junction with wheels; then the 10 anchor: recognizable 747 gear layout: two-wheel nose strut, four multi-wheel main bogies (two under the body, two under the wings), plausible strut lengths.
